description: Source code for MCP (Model Context Protocol) client in Pipecat, enabling integration with external MCP servers for LLM tool access, including schema conversion, tool registration, and communication handling.

classes.name: MCPClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with MCP servers, supporting multiple connection types (stdio, SSE, HTTP streamable), handling tool registration, schema conversion, and tool invocation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes MCPClient with server parameters, setting up connection type and filters.

methods.name: register_tools
methods.description: Discovers and registers all available MCP tools with an LLM service.

methods.name: get_tools_schema
methods.description: Retrieves schema of available MCP tools without registration.

methods.name: register_tools_schema
methods.description: Registers a given ToolsSchema with an LLM service.

methods.name: _convert_mcp_schema_to_pipecat
methods.description: Converts MCP tool schema to Pipecat's FunctionSchema format.

methods.name: _sse_list_tools
methods.description: Lists MCP tools via SSE connection.

methods.name: _sse_tool_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps MCP tool call for SSE connection.

methods.name: _stdio_list_tools
methods.description: Lists MCP tools via stdio connection.

methods.name: _stdio_tool_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps MCP tool call for stdio connection.

methods.name: _streamable_http_list_tools
methods.description: Lists MCP tools via streamable HTTP connection.

methods.name: _streamable_http_tool_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps MCP tool call for streamable HTTP connection.

methods.name: _call_tool
methods.description: Executes an MCP tool call and processes the response.

methods.name: _list_tools_helper
methods.description: Helper to list and process available MCP tools.
